sources.notes: Stalactites section; ceiling-hanging calcite deposits. Supplement NPS Growing Speleothems explicitly describes downward icicles.
sources.scope: Stylized generic five-pendant calcite stalactite group attached to shallow irregular ceiling patch. One long offset center pendant, four shorter staggered in depth, broad rooted upper junctions narrowing down to tips. No floor stalagmites or full cave.
